target_tables.workouts: name, visibility (global allowed), level beginner|intermediate|advanced, goal strength|hypertrophy|conditioning|mobility|fat_loss, equipment[] subset of bodyweight|dumbbells|barbell|kettlebell|bands|machines|cable|other, duration_min, in_library; workouts_global_tags_check requires level+goal+equipment when visibility=global
target_tables.workout_exercises: exercise_id (=catalog_id), name, position (0-based), target_sets 1-20, target_reps text, tracking reps|time|intervals|distance, target_unit reps|sec|min|km|m, target_duration_sec, target_distance_km numeric, note <=160 chars

meta.field_mapping: title->workouts.name, goal->workouts.goal, level, equipment, est_minutes->duration_min; exercises: catalog_id->exercise_id, sets->target_sets, reps_target->target_reps, duration_sec->target_duration_sec, distance_km->target_distance_km (m units stored as km/1000). slug/description/category/tags have no column yet. rest_sec has NO column in workout_exercises (keep in seed file / fold into note, or add a column).
gaps: No swim drill/kick/pull exercises: Swim 1 km uses Easy Swim, Easy Continuous Swim (Freestyle), Cool-Down Swim.

No downward dog / sun salutation / warrior poses: Yoga-style Flow uses Cow-cat, Child's Pose, High plank, Cobra Stretch, Pigeon, Lunge with Twist Stretch, Hip Airplane, butterfly yoga pose, Happy Baby.
No sit-to-stand (Chair Squat is tagged machine): Seniors Strength uses Bodyweight Squat with a "sit back to a chair" note.
No plain wall sit with clean data (Wall-sit has null category): Ski Prep uses "march sit (wall)".
Single side-plank entry is "Side plank right" (used with "per side" note).
Tabata uses a single exercise (jump squat) since intervals are per exercise.
Couch to 5K run/walk alternation modelled as intervals (rest_sec = walk recovery).
Pull-up negatives use "pull-up" with a note (no negative variant).
catalogue_data_issues: Dumbbell Thruster, Dumbbell Hip Thrust, dumbbell snatch, Dumbbell sumo deadlift, Dumbbell close grip bench press are tagged equipment=barbell
Foam Roll IT Band / Foam Roller Iliotibial band tagged resistance band
Chair Squat tagged machine; Kettlebell Swings tagged Shoulders
~200 exercises have null category; difficulty is null for all global rows
